        # From here the marker exists even if the token never lands.

        try:

                handle.write(self.token)
                handle.flush()
                os.fsync(handle.fileno())
evidence.reason: The acquisition path creates the marker with O_CREAT and fsyncs only the marker file descriptor. On Linux, fsync(file) does not make a newly created directory entry durable; without an fsync on the parent directory, a power loss after acquire can lose the marker and therefore the admission hold. The code's explicit fsync and its created/acquired distinction show it intends the token to persist, so this is a correctness repair rather than a new requirement. The same durability gap must be addressed when the marker is unlinked on release.
